createRequireFunction(manifest: PluginManifest): any {\n    return (moduleName: string) => {\n      // Whitelist allowed modules\n      const allowedModules = [\n        'axios',\n        'lodash',\n        // Add more as needed\n      ];\n\n      if (!allowedModules.includes(moduleName)) {\n        throw new Error(`Module ${moduleName} not allowed`);\n      }\n\n      return require(moduleName);\n    };\n  }\n\n  private createProxyContext(context: PluginContext, permissions: string[]): any {\n    const proxy = new Proxy(context, {\n      get: (target, prop) => {\n        // Check permissions\n        if (this.isRestricted(prop, permissions)) {\n          throw new Error(`Permission denied: ${prop}`);\n        }\n        return target[prop];\n      },\n    });\n\n    return proxy;\n  }\n\n  private isRestricted(prop: string, permissions: string[]): boolean {\n    const restricted = ['database', 'admin', 'system'];\n    return restricted.some(r => prop.toLowerCase().includes(r)) && \n           !permissions.includes(`system:${prop}`);\n  }\n\n  private parseResources(resources: any): SandboxConfig {\n    return {\n      memory: parseInt(resources.memory) || 128,\n      cpu: parseFloat(resources.cpu) || 0.5,\n      timeout: parseInt(resources.timeout) || 30000,\n      permissions: [],\n    };\n  }\n}\n\nexport class Sandbox {\n  constructor(\n    private vm: VM,\n    public context: any,\n    public config: SandboxConfig\n  ) {}\n\n  async call(fn: Function, ...args: any[]): Promise<any> {\n    try {\n      const wrappedFn = this.vm.run(`\n        (function() {\n          ${fn.toString()}\n          return ${fn.name};\n        })\n      `);\n      \n      return await wrappedfn(...args);\n    } catch (error) {\n      throw new Error(`Sandbox execution error: ${error.message}`);\n    }\n  }\n\n  getPluginCode(): any {\n    return this.vm.run('module.exports');\n  }\n\n  async destroy(): Promise<void> {\n    // Cleanup\n    this.vm = null as any;\n    this.context = null as any;\n  }\n}\n```\n\n---\n\n## 4. Plugin Lifecycle\n\n### 4.1 Lifecycle States\n\n```\n┌──────────┐\n│ DISCOVER │  Plugin discovered in plugins/ directory\n└────┬─────┘\n     │\n     ▼\n┌──────────┐\n│  LOAD    │  Load manifest, validate permissions\n└────┬─────┘\n     │\n     ▼\n┌──────────┐\n│ INIT     │  Call init() hook, initialize resources\n└────┬─────┘\n     │\n     ▼\n┌──────────┐\n│  RUN     │  Call run() hook, start processing\n└────┬─────┘\n     │\n     ▼\n┌──────────┐\n│  STOP    │  Call stop() hook, cleanup resources\n└────┬─────┘\n     │\n     ▼\n┌──────────┐\n│ UNLOAD   │  Remove from memory, destroy sandbox\n└──────────┘\n```\n\n### 4.2 Lifecycle Implementation\n\n```typescript\n// services/plugin-runtime/src/application/PluginLifecycle.ts\n\nexport enum PluginState {\n  DISCOVERED = 'discovered',\n  LOADING = 'loading',\n  LOADED = 'loaded',\n  RUNNING = 'running',\n  STOPPING = 'stopping',\n  STOPPED = 'stopped',\n  ERROR = 'error',\n}\n\nexport class PluginLifecycle {\n  constructor(\n    private pluginManager: PluginManager,\n    private eventBus: EventBus,\n    private logger: Logger\n  ) {}\n\n  async discover(pluginPath: string): Promise<PluginManifest> {\n    this.logger.info('Discovering plugin', { pluginPath });\n    \n    const manifest = await this.pluginManager.loadManifest(pluginPath);\n    \n    // Validate plugin\n    await this.validatePlugin(manifest);\n    \n    // Check dependencies\n    await this.checkDependencies(manifest);\n    \n    this.logger.info('Plugin discovered', { pluginId: manifest.id });\n    return manifest;\n  }\n\n  async load(pluginPath: string): Promise<PluginInstance> {\n    const manifest = await this.discover(pluginPath);\n    \n    this.logger.info('Loading plugin', { pluginId: manifest.id });\n    \n    try {\n      const instance = await this.pluginManager.load(pluginPath);\n      \n      // Emit event\n      await this.eventBus.publish('plugin.loaded', {\n        plugin_id: manifest.id,\n        version: manifest.version,\n        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n      });\n      \n      return instance;\n    } catch (error) {\n      this.logger.error('Plugin load failed', { pluginId: manifest.id, error });\n      \n      await this.eventBus.publish('plugin.load_failed', {\n        plugin_id: manifest.id,\n        error: error.message,\n        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n      });\n      \n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  async unload(pluginId: string): Promise<void> {\n    this.logger.info('Unloading plugin', { pluginId });\n    \n    try {\n      await this.pluginManager.unload(pluginId);\n      \n      await this.eventBus.publish('plugin.unloaded', {\n        plugin_id: pluginId,\n        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      this.logger.error('Plugin unload failed', { pluginId, error });\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  async reload(pluginId: string): Promise<void> {\n    this.logger.info('Reloading plugin', { pluginId });\n    \n    try {\n      await this.pluginManager.reload(pluginId);\n      \n      await this.eventBus.publish('plugin.reloaded', {\n        plugin_id: pluginId,\n        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      this.logger.error('Plugin reload failed', { pluginId, error });\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  async stop(pluginId: string): Promise<void> {\n    this.logger.info('Stopping plugin', { pluginId });\n    \n    const instance = this.pluginManager.getPlugin(pluginId);\n    if (!instance) return;\n\n    try {\n      await instance.sandbox.call(\n        instance.sandbox.getPluginCode().stop,\n        instance.context\n      );\n      \n      instance.status = 'stopped';\n      \n      await this.eventBus.publish('plugin.stopped', {\n        plugin_id: pluginId,\n        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      this.logger.error('Plugin stop failed', { pluginId, error });\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  private async validatePlugin(manifest: PluginManifest): Promise<void> {\n    // Validate manifest schema\n    const schema = await this.loadSchema(manifest.config.schema);\n    \n    // Check required fields\n    for (const field of manifest.config.required) {\n      if (!manifest[field]) {\n        throw new Error(`Missing required config: ${field}`);\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Validate permissions\n    await this.validatePermissions(manifest.permissions);\n  }\n\n  private async validatePermissions(permissions: string[]): Promise<void> {\n    const allowedPermissions = [\n      'network:external',\n      'network:internal',\n      'event:subscribe:*',\n      'event:publish:*',\n      'ai:tool:register',\n      'api:expose:*',\n      'database:read',\n      'database:write',\n    ];\n\n    for (const permission of permissions) {\n      const [resource, action, scope] = permission.split(':');\n      \n      const allowed = allowedPermissions.some(p => {\n        if (p.endsWith(':*')) {\n          return permission.startsWith(p.slice(0, -1));\n        }\n        return permission === p;\n      });\n\n      if (!allowed) {\n        throw new Error(`Permission not allowed: ${permission}`);\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  private async checkDependencies(manifest: PluginManifest): Promise<void> {\n    // Check if plugin dependencies are installed\n    const packagePath = path.join(manifest.path, 'package.json');\n    const Event Binding System\n\n### 5.1 Event Binding API\n\n```typescript\n// services/plugin-runtime/src/domain/EventBinding.ts\n\nexport interface EventBinding {\n  pluginId: string;\n  eventType: string;\n  handler: string;\n  filter?: EventFilter;\n  enabled: boolean;\n}\n\nexport interface EventFilter {\n  field: string;\n  operator: 'eq' | 'neq' | 'gt' | 'lt' | 'contains' | 'regex';\n  value: any;\n}\n\nexport class EventBindingSystem {\n  private bindings: Map<string, EventBinding[]> = new Map();\n\n  constructor(\n    private eventBus: EventBus,\n    private sandboxManager: SandboxManager,\n    private logger: Logger\n  ) {}\n\n  async bind(pluginId: string, eventType: string, handler: Function): Promise<void> {\n    this.logger.info('Binding event', { pluginId, eventType });\n\n    const instance = this.pluginManager.getPlugin(pluginId);\n    if (!instance) {\n      throw new Error(`Plugin ${pluginId} not loaded`);\n    }\n\n    // Subscribe to event\n    await this.eventBus.subscribe(eventType, async (event) => {\n      try {\n        // Execute handler in sandbox\n        await instance.sandbox.call(handler, event);\n      } catch (error) {\n        this.logger.error('Event handler failed', {\n          pluginId,\n          eventType,\n          error,\n        });\n      }\n    });\n\n    // Track binding\n    const pluginBindings = this.bindings.get(pluginId) || [];\n    pluginBindings.push({\n      pluginId,\n      eventType,\n      handler: handler.name,\n      enabled: true,\n    });\n    this.bindings.set(pluginId, pluginBindings);\n  }\n\n  async unbind(pluginId: string, eventType: string): Promise<void> {\n    this.logger.info('Unbinding event', { pluginId, eventType });\n\n    await this.eventBus.unsubscribe(eventType, pluginId);\n\n    const pluginBindings = this.bindings.get(pluginId) || [];\n    const filtered = pluginBindings.filter(b => b.eventType !== eventType);\n    this.bindings.set(pluginId, filtered);\n  }\n\n  getBindings(pluginId: string): EventBinding[] {\n    return this.bindings.get(pluginId) || [];\n  }\n\n  getAllBindings(): EventBinding[] {\n    return Array.from(this.bindings.values()).flat();\n  }\n}\n```\n\n### 5.2 Event Binding in Plugin\n\n```typescript\n// plugins/opensky-connector/src/events.ts\n\nexport function setupEventBindings(context) {\n  const { nats, logger } = context;\n\n  // Subscribe to osint.ingested events\n  nats.subscribe('osint.ingested', async (event) => {\n    logger.info('Received OSINT event', { eventType: event.type });\n\n    // Filter: only process aircraft events\n    if (event.payload.data.type !== 'aircraft') {\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // Enrich with OpenSky data\n    const enriched = await enrichAircraftData(event.payload);\n    \n    // Publish enriched event\n    await nats.publish('osint.normalized', {\n      ...event,\n      payload: enriched,\n    });\n  });\n\n  // Subscribe to AI searchAircraft(event.payload.payload);\n      \n      await nats.publish('ai.task.completed', {\n        correlation_id: event.id,\n        payload: {\n          task_id: event.payload.task_id,\n          result,\n        },\n      });\n    }\n  });\n}\n```\n\n---\n\n## 6. Security Model\n\n### 6.1 Sandboxing Strategy\n\n**Technology:** VM2 (vm2) — Secure JavaScript sandbox\n\n**Isolation Levels:**\n\n| Level | Description | Use Case |\n|-------|-------------|----------|\n| **L1** | Basic sandbox (no file system) | Simple plugins |\n| **L2** | Restricted file system (read-only) | Data processors |\n| **L3** | Network access (whitelisted domains) | API connectors |\n| **L4** | Full access (trusted plugins only) | Internal tools |\n\n### 6.2 Permission System\n\n```typescript\n// services/plugin-runtime/src/domain/PermissionManager.ts\n\nexport enum Permission {\n  // Network\n  NETWORK_EXTERNAL = 'network:external',\n  NETWORK_INTERNAL = 'network:internal',\n  \n  // Events\n  EVENT_SUBSCRIBE = 'event:subscribe',\n  EVENT_PUBLISH = 'event:publish',\n  \n  // AI\n  AI_TOOL_REGISTER = 'ai:tool:register',\n  AI_TOOL_EXECUTE = 'ai:tool:execute',\n  \n  // API\n  API_EXPOSE = 'api:expose',\n  API_CALL = 'api:call',\n  \n  // Database\n  DATABASE_READ = 'database:read',\n  DATABASE_WRITE = 'database:write',\n  \n  // System\n  SYSTEM_CONFIG = 'system:config',\n  SYSTEM_ADMIN = 'system:admin',\n}\n\nexport class PermissionManager {\n  private permissions: Map<string, string[]> = new Map();\n\n  constructor(private logger: Logger) {}\n\n  grant(pluginId: string, permissions: string[]): void {\n    this.logger.info('Granting permissions', { pluginId, permissions });\n    \n    const current = this.permissions.get(pluginId) || [];\n    const updated = [...new Set([...current, ...permissions])];\n    this.permissions.set(pluginId, updated);\n  }\n\n  revoke(pluginId: string, permissions: string[]): void {\n    this.logger.info('Revoking permissions', { pluginId, permissions });\n    \n    const current = this.permissions.get(pluginId) || [];\n    const updated = current.filter(p => !permissions.includes(p));\n    this.permissions.set(pluginId, updated);\n  }\n\n  has(pluginId: string, permission: string): boolean {\n    const pluginPerms = this.permissions.get(pluginId) || [];\n    return pluginPerms.includes(permission);\n  }\n\n  check(pluginId: string, permission: string): void {\n    if (!this.has(pluginId, permission)) {\n      throw new Error(`Permission denied: ${permission}`);\n    }\n  }\n\n  getAll(pluginId: string): string[] {\n    return this.permissions.get(pluginId) || [];\n  }\n}\n```\n\n### 6.3 Resource Limits\n\n```typescript\n// services/plugin-runtime/src/domain/ResourceLimiter.ts\n\nexport class ResourceLimiter {\n  private limits: Map<string, ResourceConfig> = new Map();\n  private usage: Map<string, ResourceUsage> = new Map();\n\n  constructor(private logger: Logger) {}\n\n  setLimit(pluginId: string, config: ResourceConfig): void {\n    this.limits.set(pluginId, config);\n    this.usage.set(pluginId, {\n      memory: 0,\n      cpu: 0,\n      requests: 0,\n    });\n  }\n\n  checkUsage(pluginId: string): ResourceUsage {\n    return this.usage.get(pluginId) || { memory: 0, cpu: 0, requests: 0 };\n  }\n\n  enforce(pluginId: string): void {\n    const limit = this.limits.get(pluginId);\n    const usage = this.usage.get(pluginId);\n\n    if (!limit || !usage) return;\n\n    // Check memory\n    if (usage.memory > limit.memory) {\n      throw new Error(`Memory limit exceeded: ${usage.memory}MB > ${limit.memory}MB`);\n    }\n\n    // Check CPU\n    if (usage.cpu > limit.cpu) {\n      throw new Error(`CPU limit exceeded: ${usage.cpu} > ${limit.cpu}`);\n    }\n\n    // Check requests\n    if (usage.requests > limit.requestsPerSecond) {\n      throw new Error(`Rate limit exceeded: ${usage.requests}/s > ${limit.requestsPerSecond}/s`);\n    }\n  }\n\n  increment(pluginId: string, resource: keyof ResourceUsage): void {\n    const usage = this.usage.get(pluginId);\n    if (usage) {\n      usage[resource]++;\n    }\n  }\n}\n\ninterface ResourceConfig {\n  memory: number; // MB\n  cpu: number;    // CPU cores\n  timeout: number; // MS\n  requestsPerSecond: number;\n}\n\ninterface ResourceUsage {\n  memory: number;\n  cpu: number;\n  requests: number;\n}\n```\n\n### 6.4 Security Policies\n\n```yaml\n# Security policies for plugins\n\npolicies:\n  # ## Architecture Highlights

### Technology Stack
- **API Gateway**: Kong (Go)
- **BFF**: Apollo Server (Node.js, GraphQL)

- **Search**: Qdrant (vector) + Elasticsearch (full-text)
- **IOC Engine**: Go

- **Plugin Runtime**: Node.js
- **Event Bus**: NATS JetStream
- **Databases**: PostgreSQL 16, Redis 7, MinIO
- **Observability**: Grafana Alloy, Loki, Prometheus, Tempo, Grafana

### Key Design Principles
✅ **Distributed-first** — 15 microservices, no monoliths  
✅ **Event-driven** — NATS JetStream for ALL communication  
✅ **Plugin-based** — Hot-loadable modules with sandboxing  
✅ **API-first** — REST + GraphQL + gRPC contracts  
✅ **Zero-trust** — mTLS, RBAC, network isolation  
✅ **Observable** — All logs/metrics/traces through Alloy  
✅ **Clean Architecture** — Domain layer has zero framework dependencies

Agent Architecture\n\n### 2.1 Agent Interface\n\n```typescript\n// libs/ai-engine/src/domain/Agent.ts\n\nexport interface AgentConfig {\n  id: string;\n  name: string;\n  type: AgentType;\n  model: string;\n  temperature: number;\n  maxTokens: number;\n  tools: string[];\n  systemPrompt: string;\n}\n\nexport enum AgentType {\n  PLANNER = 'planner',\n  ANALYST = 'analyst',\n  THREAT_INTEL = 'threat_intel',\n  GEOINT = 'geoint',\n  GRAPH = 'graph',\n  SEARCH = 'search',\n}\n\nexport interface AgentContext {\n  taskId: string;\n  userId: string;\n  memory: SharedMemory;\n  tools: ToolRegistry;\n  eventBus: EventBus;\n  logger: Logger;\n}\n\nexport interface AgentResult {\n  agentId: string;\n  taskId: string;\n  status: 'success' | 'error' | 'partial';\n  output: any;\n  reasoning?: string;\n  toolsUsed: string[];\n  duration: number;\n  tokensUsed: number;\n}\n\nexport abstract class BaseAgent {\n  protected config: AgentConfig;\n  protected context: AgentContext;\n\n  constructor(config: AgentConfig, context: AgentContext) {\n    this.config = config;\n    this.context = context;\n  }\n\n  // Abstract methods\n  abstract execute(input: any): Promise<AgentResult>;\n  abstract canHandle(task: Task): boolean;\n\n  // Common methods\n  async think(prompt: string): Promise<string> {\n    // Call LLM\n    const response = await this.callLLM(prompt);\n    return response;\n  }\n\n  async useTool(toolName: string, params: any): Promise<any> {\n    const tool = this.context.tools.get(toolName);\n    if (!tool) {\n      throw new Error(`Tool not found: ${toolName}`);\n    }\n    return tool.execute(params);\n  }\n\n  async publishEvent(eventType: string, payload: any): Promise<void> {\n    await this.context.eventBus.publish(eventType, {\n      task_id: this.context.taskId,\n      agent_id: this.config.id,\n      payload,\n    });\n  }\n\n  protected abstract callLLM(prompt: string): Promise<string>;\n}\n```\n\n### 2.2 Agent Implementations\n\n#### Planner Agent\n\n```typescript\n// libs/ai-engine/src/agents/PlannerAgent.ts\n\nexport class PlannerAgent extends BaseAgent {\n  async Communication Model\n\n### 3.1 Event-Driven Communication\n\nAll agent communication happens via NATS JetStream. No direct HTTP calls between agents.\n\n**Event Types:**\n\n| Event | Producer | Consumer | Purpose |\n|-------|----------|----------|---------|\n| `ai.task.created` | Orchestrator | Agent workers | New task assigned |\n| `ai.task.completed` | Agent | Orchestrator | Task result |\n| `ai.agent.started` | Agent | Orchestrator | Agent started processing |\n| `ai.agent.progress` | Agent | Orchestrator | Progress update |\n| `ai.plan.created` | Planner | All agents | Execution plan |\n| `ai.tool.invoked` | Agent | Monitoring | Tool usage tracking |\n| `ai.memory.stored` | Agent | Memory layer | Memory update |\n\n### 3.2 Agent Communication Protocol\n\n```typescript\n// libs/ai-engine/src/infrastructure/nats/AgentNATSClient.ts\n\nexport class AgentNATSClient {\n  constructor(\n    private nats: NATS,\n    private agentId: string,\n    private logger: Logger\n  ) {}\n\n  async subscribeToTasks(): Promise<void> {\n    // Subscribe to tasks assigned to this agent\n    await this.nats.subscribe(`ai.task.${this.agentId}`, async (msg) => {\n      const task = JSON.parse(msg.data);\n      await this.handleTask(task);\n    });\n  }\n\n  async publishResult(result: AgentResult): Promise<void> {\n    await this.nats.publish('ai.task.completed', {\n      task_id: result.taskId,\n      agent_id: result.agentId,\n      status: result.status,\n      output: result.output,\n      duration: result.duration,\n    });\n  }\n\n  async requestTool(toolName: string, params: any): Promise<any> {\n    // Request tool execution from tool service\n    const response = await this.nats.request('ai.tool.execute', {\n      tool_name: toolName,\n      params,\n      agent_id: this.agentId,\n    }, {\n      timeout: 30000,\n    });\n\n    return JSON.parse(response.data);\n  }\n\n  private async handleTask(task: Task): Promise<void> {\n    this.logger.info('Handling task', { taskId: task.id });\n    \n    await this.nats.publish('ai.agent.started', {\n      task_id: task.id,\n      agent_id: this.agentId,\n    });\n\n    try {\n      const result = await this.executeTask(task);\n      await this.publishResult(result);\n    } catch (error) {\n      this.logger.error('Task failed', { taskId: task.id, error });\n      await this.publishResult({\n        agentId: this.agentId,\n        taskId: task.id,\n        status: 'error',\n        output: null,\n        reasoning: error.message,\n        toolsUsed: [],\n        duration: 0,\n        tokensUsed: 0,\n      });\n    }\n  }\n\n  private async executeTask(task: Task): Promise<AgentResult> {\n    // Implementation depends on agent type\n    return {} as AgentResult;\n  }\n}\n```\n\n---\n\n## 4. Memory System Design\n\n### 4.1 Shared Memory Architecture\n\n```\n┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│                    AI Engine — Shared Memory System                      │\n└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n\n                                    ┌──────────────┐\n                                    │   Agent ▼\n┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│  Memory Manager                                                          │\n│  ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │\n│  │  Short-term Memory (Redis)                                          │ │\n│  │  - Current task context                                              │ │\n│  │  - Conversation history                                              │ │\n│  │  - TTL: 1 hour                                                       │ │\n│  └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ │\n│  ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │\n│  │  Long-term Memory (PostgreSQL)                                       │ │\n│  │  - Entity knowledge                                                  │ │\n│  │  - Learned patterns                                                   │ │\n│  │  - TTL: Permanent                                                     │ │\n│  └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ │\n│  ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │\n│  │  Graph Memory (Neo4j)                                                │ │\n│  │  - Entity relationships                                               │ │\n│  │  - Knowledge graph                                                    │ │\n│  │  - TTL: Permanent                                                     │ │\n│  └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ │\n│  ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │\n│  │  Vector Memory (Qdrant)                                              │ │\n│  │  - Semantic embeddings                                                │ │\n│  │  - Similarity search                                                  │ │\n│  │  - TTL: Permanent                                                     │ │\n│  └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ │\n└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n```\n\n### 4.2 Memory Interface\n\n```typescript\n// libs/ai-engine/src/domain/Memory.ts\n\nexport interface MemoryEntry {\n  id: string;\n  taskId: string;\n  agentId: string;\n  type: MemoryType;\n  key: string;\n  value: any;\n  embedding?: number[];\n  metadata: {\n    created: Date;\n    expires?: Date;\n    importance: number; // 0-1\n    tags: string[];\n  };\n}\n\nexport enum MemoryType {\n  CONTEXT = 'context',           // Current task context\n  ENTITY = 'entity',             // Entity information\n  RELATIONSHIP = 'relationship', // Entity relationships\n  PATTERN = 'pattern',           // Learned patterns\n  TOOL_RESULT = 'tool_result',   // Tool execution results\n  REASONING = 'reasoning',       // Agent reasoning\n}\n\nexport interface SharedMemory {\n  // Short-term memory (Redis)\n  store(key: string, value: any, ttl?: number): Promise<void>;\n  retrieve(key: string): Promise<any>;\n  retrieveAll(prefix?: string): Promise<Map<string, any>>;\n  delete(key: string): Promise<void>;\n\n  // Long-term memory (PostgreSQL)\n  storePermanent(key: string, value: any, metadata?: any): Promise<void>;\n  search(query: string, limit?: number): Promise<MemoryEntry[]>;\n\n  // Graph memory (Neo4j)\n  storeEntity(entity: Entity): Promise<void>;\n  storeRelationship(relationship: Relationship): Promise<void>;\n  getEntityGraph(entityId: string, depth: number): Promise<Graph>;\n\n  // Vector memory (Qdrant)\n  storeEmbedding(key: string, embedding: number[], metadata: any): Promise<void>;\n  similaritySearch(embedding: number[], limit: number): Promise<MemoryEntry[]>;\n}\n\nexport class MemoryManager implements SharedMemory {\n  constructor(\n    private redis: Redis,\n    private postgres: Database,\n    private neo4j: Neo4j,\n    private qdrant: Qdrant,\n    private logger: Logger\n  ) {}\n\n  async store(key: string, value: any, ttl: number = 3600): Promise<void> {\n    const memoryKey = `memory:${this.context.taskId}:${key}`;\n    await this.redis.setex(memoryKey, ttl, JSON.stringify(value));\n  }\n\n  async retrieve(key: string): Promise<any> {\n    const memoryKey = `memory:${this.context.taskId}:${key}`;\n    const data = await this.redis.get(memoryKey);\n    return data ? JSON.parse(data) : null;\n  }\n\n  async storePermanent(key: string, value: any, metadata: any = {}): Promise<void> {\n    await this.postgres.query(\n      `INSERT INTO ai_memory (id, task_id, key, value, metadata) \n       VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5)`,\n      [uuid(), this.context.taskId, key, JSON.stringify(value), metadata]\n    );\n  }\n\n  async storeEntity(entity: Entity): Promise<void> {\n    await this.neo4j.run(\n      `MERGE (e:Entity {id: $id})\n       SET e.type = $type,\n           e.name = $name,\n           e.confidence = $confidence,\n           e.updated_at = datetime()`,\n      {\n        id: entity.id,\n        type: entity.type,\n        name: entity.name,\n        confidence: entity.confidence,\n      }\n    );\n  }\n\n  async storeEmbedding(key: string, embedding: number[], metadata: any): Promise<void> {\n    await this.qdrant.upsert('embeddings', {\n      id: key,\n      vector: embedding,\n      payload: metadata,\n    });\n  }\n\n  async similaritySearch(embedding: number[], limit: number = 10): Promise<MemoryEntry[]> {\n    const results = await this.qdrant.search('embeddings', {\n      vector: embedding,\n      limit,\n    });\n\n    return results.map(r => ({\n      id: r.id,\n      value: r.payload,\n      score: r.score,\n    }));\n  }\n}\n```\n\n### 4.3 Context Builder\n\n```typescript\n// libs/ai-engine/src/application/ContextBuilder.ts\n\nexport class ContextBuilder {\n  constructor(private memory: SharedMemory) {}\n\n  async buildContext(task: Task, agents: BaseAgent[]): Promise<Context> {\n    // 1. Retrieve task history\n    const history = await this.memory.retrieveAll(`task:${task.id}:`);\n    \n    // 2. Retrieve related entities\n    const entities = await this.memory.search(task.query, 10);\n    \n    // 3. Retrieve similar past tasks\n    const similarTasks = await this.findSimilarTasks(task);\n    \n    // 4. Build context window\n    const contextWindow = await this.buildContextWindow(task, history, entities);\n    \n    // 5. Retrieve agent capabilities\n    const agentCapabilities = agents.map(a => ({\n      id: a.config.id,\n      name: a.config.name,\n      tools: a.config.tools,\n    }));\n\n    return {\n      task,\n      history,\n      entities,\n      similarTasks,\n      contextWindow,\n      agentCapabilities,\n    };\n  }\n\n  private async findSimilarTasks(task: Task): Promise<Task[]> {\n    // Use vector similarity to find similar past tasks\n    const embedding = await this.generateEmbedding(task.query);\n    const similar = await this.memory.similaritySearch(embedding, 5);\n    \n    return similar.map(s => s.value.task);\n  }\n\n  private async buildContextWindow(\n    task: Task,\n    history: any[],\n    entities: any[]\n  ): Promise<string> {\n    const parts: string[] = [];\n    \n    // Add task description\n    parts.push(`Task: ${task.query}`);\n    \n    // Add relevant history\n    if (history.length > 0) {\n      parts.push(`\\nPrevious steps:\\n${history.map(h => h.value).join('\\n')}`);\n    }\n    \n    // Add relevant entities\n    if (entities.length > 0) {\n      parts.push(`\\nRelated entities:\\n${entities.map(e => e.value).join('\\n')}`);\n    }\n    \n    return parts.join('\\n');\n  }\n\n  private async generateEmbedding(text: string): Promise<number[]> {\n    // Use embedding model (e.g., OpenAI text-embedding-ada-002)\n    return [];\n  }\n}\n```\n\n---\n\n## 5. Tool Execution System\n\n### 5.1 Tool Registry\n\n```typescript\n// libs/ai-engine/src/domain/ToolRegistry.ts\n\nexport interface Tool {\n  name: string;\n  description: string;\n  parameters: JSONSchema;\n  execute: (params: any) => Promise<any>;\n  timeout: number;\n  retryable: boolean;\n}\n\nexport interface ToolResult {\n  success: boolean;\n  data: any;\n  error?: string;\n  duration: number;\n}\n\nexport class ToolRegistry {\n  private tools: Map<string, Tool> = new Map();\n\n  register(tool: Tool): void {\n    this.logger.info('Registering tool', { name: tool.name });\n    this.tools.set(tool.name, tool);\n  }\n\n  get(name: string): Tool | undefined {\n    return this.tools.get(name);\n  }\n\n  getAll(): Tool[] {\n    return Array.from(this.tools.values());\n  }\n\n  async execute(name: string, params: any): Promise<ToolResult> {\n    const tool = this.tools.get(name);\n    if (!tool) {\n      return {\n        success: false,\n        data: null,\n        error: `Tool not found: ${name}`,\n        duration: 0,\n      };\n    }\n\n    const startTime = Date.now();\n    \n    try {\n      const data = await Promise.race([\n        tool.execute(params),\n        new Promise((_, reject) => \n          setTimeout(() => reject(new Error('Tool timeout')), tool.timeout)\n        ),\n      ]);\n\n      return {\n        success: true,\n        data,\n        duration: Date.now() - startTime,\n      };\n    } catch (error) {\n      return {\n        success: false,\n        data: null,\n        error: error.message,\n        duration: Date.now() - startTime,\n      };\n    }\n  }\n}\n```\n\n### 5.2 Built-in Tools\n\n```typescript\n// libs/ai-engine/src/tools/DatabaseTools.ts\n\nexport class DatabaseTools {\n  constructor(private db: Database) Orchestration Flow\n\n### 6.1 LangGraph State Machine\n\n```typescript\n// libs/ai-engine/src/orchestration/Orchestrator.ts\n\nimport { StateGraph, END } from '@langchain/langgraph';\n\nexport interface AgentState {\n  task: Task;\n  plan: Plan;\n  currentStep: number;\n  results: Map<number, AgentResult>;\n  context: Context;\n  error?: string;\n}\n\nexport class AIOrchestrator {\n  private graph: StateGraph<AgentState>;\n  private agents: Map<AgentType, BaseAgent>;\n  private memory: SharedMemory;\n  private eventBus: EventBus;\n\n  constructor() {\n    this.agents = new Map();\n    this.memory = {} as SharedMemory;\n    this.eventBus = {} as EventBus;\n    this.graph = this.buildGraph();\n  }\n\n  private buildGraph(): StateGraph<AgentState> {\n    const graph = new StateGraph<AgentState>({\n      channels: {\n        task: { value: (x, y) => y },\n        plan: { value: (x, y) => y },\n        currentStep: { value: (x, y) => y },\n        results: { value: (x, y) => new Map([...x, ...y]) },\n        context: { value: (x, y) => y },\n        error: { value: (x, y) => y || x },\n      },\n    });\n\n    // Define nodes\n    graph.addNode('planner', this.plannerNode.bind(this));\n    graph.addNode('execute_step', this.executeStepNode.bind(this));\n    graph.addNode('synthesize', this.synthesizeNode.bind(this));\n\n    // Define edges\n    graph.addEdge('__start__', 'planner');\n    graph.addConditionalEdges('planner', this.shouldContinue.bind(this));\n    graph.addEdge('execute_step', 'synthesize');\n    graph.addEdge('synthesize', END);\n\n    return graph;\n  }\n\n  private plannerNode(state: AgentState): Partial<AgentState> {\n    const planner = this.agents.get(AgentType.PLANNER) as PlannerAgent;\n    \n    const plan = planner.execute({\n      query: state.task.query,\n      context: state.context,\n    });\n\n    return {\n      plan,\n      currentStep: 0,\n    };\n  }\n\n  private executeStepNode(state: AgentState): Partial<AgentState> {\n    const step = state.plan.steps[state.currentStep];\n    const agent = this.agents.get(step.agentType);\n    \n    if (!agent) {\n      throw new Error(`Agent not found: ${step.agentType}`);\n    }\n\n    const result = agent.execute({\n      ...step.input,\n      context: state.context,\n    });\n\n    const newResults = new Map(state.results);\n    newResults.set(state.currentStep, result);\n\n    return {\n      results: newResults,\n      currentStep: state.currentStep + 1,\n    };\n  }\n\n  private synthesizeNode(state: AgentState): Partial<AgentState> {\n    // Synthesize results from all agents\n    const synthesis = this.synthesizeResults(state.results);\n    return {\n      task: {\n        ...state.task,\n        result: synthesis,\n        status: 'completed',\n      },\n    };\n  }\n\n  private shouldContinue(state: AgentState): string {\n    if (state.error) return 'synthesize';\n    if (state.currentStep >= state.plan.steps.length) return 'synthesize';\n    return 'execute_step';\n  }\n\n  private synthesizeResults(results: Map<number, AgentResult>): any {\n    // Combine results from all agents\n    const synthesis = {\n      summary: '',\n      findings: [],\n      recommendations: [],\n      confidence: 0,\n    };\n\n    for (const [step, result] of results) {\n      if (result.status === 'success') {\n        synthesis.findings.push(result.output);\n      }\n    }\n\n    return synthesis;\n  }\n\n  async execute(task: Task): Promise<TaskResult> {\n    const context = await this.contextBuilder.buildContext(task, Array.from(this.agents.values()));\n    \n    const initialState: AgentState = {\n      task,\n      plan: { steps: [] },\n      currentStep: 0,\n      results: new Map(),\n      context,\n    };\n\n    const result = await this.graph.invoke(initialState);\n    return result.task.result;\n  }\n}\n```\n\n### 6.2 Execution Flow\n\n```\nUser Query: \"Analyze threat actor APT29\"\n    │\n    ▼\n[Orchestrator] ──publish──▶ [NATS: ai.task.created]\n                                    │\n                                    ▼\n                            [Planner Agent]\n                                    │\n                                    │ Creates plan:\n                                    │ 1. Search for APT29\n                                    │ 2. Find related entities\n                                    │ 3. Match IOCs\n                                    │ 4. Analyze TTPs\n                                    │ 5. Generate report\n                                    ▼\n                            [NATS: ai.plan.created]\n                                    │\n                                    ▼\n                    ┌───────────────┼───────────────┐\n                    │               │               │\n                    ▼               ▼               ▼\n            [Search Agent]  [Graph Agent]  [Threat Intel Agent]\n                    │               │               │\n                    │               │               │\n                    ▼               ▼               ▼\n            [Search results] [Entity graph] [IOC matches]\n                    │               │               │\n                    └───────────────┼───────────────┘\n                                    │\n                                    ▼\n                            [Analyst Agent]\n                                    │\n                                    │ Synthesizes findings\n                                    ▼\n                            [Final Report]\n                                    │\n                                    ▼\n                            [NATS: ai.task.completed]\n                                    │\n                                    ▼\n                            [User receives result]\n```\n\n---\n\n## 7. # ✅ OSIRIS-Lab v2 — Complete Multi-Agent AI Framework Design

## Deliverable

**`docs/AI_ENGINE.md`** — Complete AI Engine architecture document (9 sections, 2,200+ lines)

## Architecture Summary

### 1. Agent Architecture

**6 Specialized Agents:**

| Agent | Responsibility | Tools | Model |
|-------|---------------|-------|-------|
| **Planner** | Task decomposition, agent assignment | Planning tools | GPT-4/Claude |
| **Analyst** | Data analysis, pattern recognition | DB queries, analytics | GPT-4 |
| **Threat Intel** | IOC matching, attribution, campaigns | Threat intel DBs | GPT-4 + fine-tuned |
| **GEOINT** | Geospatial analysis, movement tracking | Map APIs, GeoJSON | GPT-4 + code |
| **Graph** | Entity resolution, relationship mapping | Neo4j, graph algorithms | GPT-4 |
| **Search** | Semantic search, full-text search | Qdrant, Elasticsearch | Embeddings + GPT |

### 2. Communication Model

**Event-Driven via NATS JetStream:**
- `ai.task.created` — Orchestrator → Agent workers
- `ai.task.completed` — Agent → Orchestrator
- `ai.plan.created` — Planner → All agents
- `ai.agent.started` — Agent → Orchestrator
- `ai.tool.invoked` — Agent → Monitoring
- No direct HTTP calls between agents

### 3. Memory System

**4-Layer Shared Memory:**

| Layer | Technology | Purpose | TTL |
|-------|-----------|---------|-----|
| **Short-term** | Redis | Current task context, conversation history | 1 hour |
| **Long-term** | PostgreSQL | Entity knowledge, learned patterns | Permanent |
| **Graph** | Neo4j | Entity relationships, knowledge graph | Permanent |
| **Vector** | Qdrant | Semantic embeddings, similarity search | Permanent |

### 4. Tool Execution System

**Tool Registry with:**
- Timeout enforcement (30s default)
- Retry logic (3 attempts, exponential backoff)
- Built-in tools:
  - `postgres_query` — SQL queries
  - `neo4j_query` — Cypher queries
  - `entity_search` — Entity search
  - `semantic_search` — Vector search
  - `fulltext_search` — Elasticsearch

### 5. Orchestration Flow

**LangGraph State Machine:**
```
User Query → Planner (creates plan) → Execute Steps (parallel agents) → Synthesize → Result
```

**Example Execution (APT29 Analysis):**
- Step 1: Search Agent finds APT29 entity (1.5s)
- Step 2: Graph Agent retrieves relationships (3.0s)
- Step 3: Threat Intel Agent matches IOCs (25.0s)
- Step 4: Analyst Agent synthesizes findings (5.0s)
- **Total: 45 seconds**

### 6. Key Features

✅ **Multi-Agent Orchestration** — LangGraph-based state machine  
✅ **6 Specialized Agents** — Each with specific expertise  
✅ **Shared Memory** — 4-layer memory system  
✅ **Tool Registry** — Extensible with timeout/retry  
✅ **Event-Driven** — All communication via NATS  
✅ **Context Builder** — Intelligent context window construction  
✅ **Scalable** — Horizontal scaling of agent workers  
✅ **Observable** — Full tracing and logging

   // associated, affiliated, member_of\n  confidence: 85,               // 0-100\n  source: \"osint-source-1\",\n  first_seen: \"2025-01-01\",\n  last_seen: \"2025-06-18\",\n  created_at: ioc_value FOR (i:IOC) ON (i.value);\nCREATE INDEX ioc_severity FOR (i:IOC) ON (i.severity);\nCREATE INDEX ioc_threat_type FOR (i:IOC) ON (i.threat_type);\n\n// System indexes\nCREATE INDEX system_hostname FOR (s:System) ON (s.hostname);\nCREATE INDEX system_ip FOR (s:System) ON (s.ip_address);\nCREATE INDEX system_status FOR (s:System) ON (s.status);\nCREATE INDEX system_criticality FOR (s:System) ON (s.criticality);\n\n// Event indexes\nCREATE INDEX event_type FOR (e:Event) ON (e.type);\nCREATE INDEX event_timestamp FOR (e:Event) ON (e.timestamp);\nCREATE INDEX event_severity FOR (e:Event) ON (e.severity);\nCREATE INDEX event_status FOR (e:Event) ON (e.status);\n\n// GeoLocation indexes\nCREATE INDEX geo_country FOR (g:GeoLocation) ON (g.country);\nCREATE INDEX geo_city FOR (g:GeoLocation) ON (g.city);\n\n// Full-text search\nCREATE FULLTEXT INDEX entity_fulltext FOR (e:Entity) ON EACH [e.name, e.description, e.aliases];\nCREATE FULLTEXT INDEX document_fulltext FOR Query Examples\n\n### 5.1 Entity Resolution\n\n```cypher\n// Find all entities matching a name (fuzzy match)\nMATCH (e:Entity)\nWHERE e.name =~ '(?i).*apt29.*'\n   OR ANY(alias IN e.aliases WHERE max(event.timestamp) AS last_seen\nORDER BY event_count DESC;\n\n// Find systems communicating with malicious IOCs\nMATCH (s:System)-[:COMMUNICATES_WITH]->(ioc:IOC {severity: \"critical\"})\nMATCH (ioc)<-[:USES]-(ta:ThreatActor)\nRETURN \n  s.hostname AS system,\n  s.ip_address AS ip,\n  ioc.value AS malicious_ioc,\n  ta.name AS threat_actor,\n  count(*) AS connection_count\nORDER BY connection_count DESC;\n```\n\n### 5.3 Threat Actor Analysis\n\n```cypher\n// Get full threat actor profile\nMATCH (ta:ThreatActor {name: \"APT29\"})\nOPTIONAL MATCH collect(DISTINCT tool) AS tools,\n  collect(DISTINCT campaign) AS campaigns;\n\n// Find threat actor relationships\nMATCH (ta1:ThreatActor {name: \"APT29\"})-[:RELATED_TO]-(ta2:ThreatActor)\nRETURN ta1, ta2, type(relationship) AS relationship_type\nORDER BY relationship.confidence DESC;\n```\n\n### 5.4 Geospatial Analysis\n\n```cypher\n// Find events by location\nMATCH loc.name AS location,\n  count(DISTINCT malicious) AS malicious_events,\n  count(DISTINCT event) AS total_events,\n  round(100.0 * count(DISTINCT malicious) / count(DISTINCT event), 2) AS threat_percentage\nORDER BY threat_percentage DESC;\n```\n\n### 5.5 Temporal Analysis\n\n```cypher\n// Find events in time range\nMATCH (e:Event)\nWHERE e.timestamp >= datetime(\"2025-06-01\") \n  AND Traversal\n\n```cypher\n// Find 3-hop relationships from entity\nMATCH path = (start:Entity {id: \"uuid\"})-[:LINKED_TO|OBSERVED_IN|GENERATED_BY|RELATED_TO*1..3]-(end)\nRETURN \n  start.name AS entities,\n  count(*) AS size\nORDER BY size DESC;\n\n// Centrality analysis (find important nodes)\nCALL gds.pageRank.stream('entity-graph')\nYIELD nodeId, score\nMATCH (n) WHERE id(n) = nodeId\nRETURN \n  n.name AS entity_name,\n  n.type AS entity_type,\n  score AS pageRank\nORDER BY pageRank DESC\nLIMIT 20;\n```\n\n---\n\n## 6. Ingestion Mapping\n\n### 6.1 OSINT Data Ingestion Flow\n\n```\nOSINT Source (API/Feed/Scraper)\n    │\n    ▼\n[Ingestion Service]\n    │\n    ├─► Extract entities (NER)\n    ├─► Extract IOCs\n    ├─► Extract relationships\n    │\n    ▼\n[Normalization Service]\n    │\n    ├─► Normalize entity names\n    ├─► Resolve duplicates\n    ├─► Assign confidence scores\n    │\n    ▼\n[Graph Builder Service]\n    │\n    ├─► Create/update nodes\n    ├─► Create/update edges\n    ├─► Update timestamps\n    │\n    ▼\n[Neo4j Graph Database]\n```\n\n### 6.2 Entity Extraction Mapping\n\n```typescript\n// libs/graph-service/src/mapping/EntityExtractor.ts\n\nexport class EntityExtractor {\n  async extract(text: string, source: string): Promise<ExtractedEntities> {\n    const entities: ExtractedEntity[] = [];\n    \n    // 1. Extract named entities (using spaCy/NER model)\n    const nerResults = await this.nerModel.extract(text);\n    \n    for (const ner of nerResults) {\n      const entity = await this.mapNerToEntity(ner, source);\n      entities.push(entity);\n    }\n    \n    // 2. Extract IOCs (using regex patterns)\n    const iocs = await this.extractIOCs(text, source);\n    entities.push(...iocs);\n    \n    // 3. Extract relationships\n    const relationships = await this.extractRelationships(text, entities);\n    \n    return { entities, relationships };\n  }\n\n  private async mapNerToEntity(ner: NERResult, source: string): Promise<ExtractedEntity> {\n    const entityType = this.mapNerTypeToEntityType(ner.label);\n    \n    return {\n      type: entityType,\n      name: ner.text,\n      confidence: ner.confidence,\n      source,\n      metadata: {\n        ner_model: 'spacy_en_core_web_lg',\n        start_pos: ner.start,\n        end_pos: ner.end,\n      },\n    };\n  }\n\n  private mapNerTypeToEntityType(nerType: string): EntityType {\n    const mapping: Record<string, EntityType> = {\n      'PERSON': EntityType.PERSON,\n      'ORG': EntityType.ORGANIZATION,\n      'GPE': EntityType.LOCATION,\n      'IP': EntityType.IP_ADDRESS,\n      'URL': EntityType.URL,\n      'EMAIL': EntityType.EMAIL,\n      'HASH': EntityType.HASH,\n      'MALWARE': EntityType.MALWARE,\n    };\n    \n    return mapping[nerType] || EntityType.UNKNOWN;\n  }\n\n  private async extractIOCs(text: string, source: string): Promise<ExtractedEntity[]> {\n    const iocs: ExtractedEntity[] = [];\n    \n    // IP addresses\n    const ipRegex = /\\b(?:\\d{1,3}\\.){3}\\d{1,3}\\b/g;\n    const ips = text.match(ipRegex) || [];\n    for (const ip of ips) {\n      iocs.push({\n        type: EntityType.IP_ADDRESS,\n        name: ip,\n        value: ip,\n        confidence: 100,\n        source,\n      });\n    }\n    \n    // Domains\n    const domainRegex = /\\b[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9-]{0,61}[a-zA-Z0-9]\\.[a-zA-Z]{2,}\\b/g;\n    const domains = text.match(domainRegex) || [];\n    for (const domain of domains) {\n      iocs.push({\n        type: EntityType.DOMAIN,\n        name: domain,\n        value: domain,\n        confidence: 100,\n        source,\n      });\n    }\n    \n    // Hashes (MD5, SHA1, SHA256)\n    const hashRegex = /\\b[a-fA-F0-9]{32,64}\\b/g;\n    const hashes = text.match(hashRegex) || [];\n    for (const hash of hashes) {\n      const hashType = hash.length === 32 ? 'md5' : hash.length === 40 ? 'sha1' : 'sha256';\n      iocs.push({\n        type: EntityType.HASH,\n        name: hash,\n        value: hash,\n        hash_type: hashType,\n        confidence: 100,\n        source,\n      });\n    }\n    \n    return iocs;\n  }\n}\n```\n\n### 6.3 Graph Builder Mapping\n\n```typescript\n// libs/graph-service/src/mapping/GraphBuilder.ts\n\nexport class GraphBuilder {\n  constructor(private neo4j: Neo4jClient) {}\n\n  async buildGraph(extracted: ExtractedEntities): Promise<void> {\n    const session = this.neo4j.session();\n    \n    try {\n      // 1. Create/update entities\n      for (const entity of extracted.entities) {\n        await this.upsertEntity(session, entity);\n      }\n      \n      // 2. Create relationships\n      for (const rel of extracted.relationships) {\n        await this.upsertRelationship(session, rel);\n      }\n      \n      // 3. Update entity graph\n      await this.updateEntityGraph(session, extracted.entities);\n      \n      await session.commit();\n    } catch (error) {\n      await session.rollback();\n      throw error;\n    } finally {\n      await session.close();\n    }\n  }\n\n  private async upsertEntity(session: Session, entity: ExtractedEntity): Promise<void> {\n    const query = `\n      MERGE (e:Entity {id: $id})\n      ON CREATE SET\n        e.type = $type,\n        e.name = $name,\n        e.confidence = $confidence,\n        e.source = $source,\n        e.first_seen = datetime(),\n        e.created_at = datetime()\n      ON MATCH SET\n        e.confidence = CASE \n          WHEN $confidence > e.confidence THEN $confidence \n          ELSE e.confidence \n        END,\n        e.last_seen = datetime(),\n        e.updated_at = datetime(),\n        e.metadata = apoc.map.merge(e.metadata, $metadata)\n      RETURN e\n    `;\n    \n    await session.run(query, {\n      id: entity.id,\n      type: entity.type,\n      name: entity.name,\n      confidence: entity.confidence,\n      source: entity.source,\n      metadata: entity.metadata || {},\n    });\n  }\n\n  private async upsertRelationship(session: Session, rel: ExtractedRelationship): Promise<void> {\n    const query = `\n      MATCH (source:Entity {id: $source_id})\n      MATCH (target:Entity {id: $target_id})\n      MERGE (source)-[r:LINKED_TO {id: $id}]->(target)\n      ON CREATE SET\n        r.type = $type,\n        r.confidence = $confidence,\n        r.source = $source,\n        r.created_at = datetime()\n      ON MATCH SET\n        r.confidence = CASE \n          WHEN $confidence > r.confidence THEN $confidence \n          ELSE r.confidence \n        END,\n        r.updated_at = datetime()\n      RETURN r\n    `;\n    \n    await session.run(query, {\n      id: rel.id,\n      source_id: rel.source_id,\n      target_id: rel.target_id,\n      type: rel.type,\n      confidence: rel.confidence,\n      source: rel.source,\n    });\n  }\n\n  private async updateEntityGraph(session: Session, entities: ExtractedEntity[]): Promise<void> {\n    // Update entity relationships based on co-occurrence\n    for (let i = 0; i < entities.length; i++) {\n      for (let j = i + 1; j < entities.length; j++) {\n        const e1 = entities[i];\n        const e2 = entities[j];\n        \n        // Create RELATED_TO relationship for co-occurring entities\n        const query = `\n          MATCH (e1:Entity {id: $e1_id})\n          MATCH (e2:Entity {id: $e2_id})\n          MERGE (e1)-[r:RELATED_TO {id: $id}]->(e2)\n          ON CREATE SET\n            r.type = 'co_occurrence',\n            r.confidence = $confidence,\n            r.source = $source,\n            r.first_seen = datetime(),\n            r.created_at = datetime()\n          ON MATCH SET\n            r.confidence = r.confidence + 1,\n            r.last_seen = datetime(),\n            r.updated_at = datetime()\n          RETURN r\n        `;\n        \n        await session.run(query, {\n          id: uuid(),\n          e1_id: e1.id,\n          e2_id: e2.id,\n          confidence: Math.min(e1.confidence, e2.confidence),\n          source: 'co_occurrence',\n        });\n      }\n    }\n  }\n}\n```\n\n---\n\n## 7. AI Usage Over Graph\n\n### 7.1 Graph-Based AI Features\n\n#### Entity Resolution\n\n```cypher\n// Find duplicate entities using graph similarity\nMATCH (e1:Entity)\nMATCH (e2:Entity)\nWHERE e1.id <> e2.id\n  AND e1.name = e2.name\n  AND e1.type = e2.type\n  AND e1.confidence > 80\n  AND e2.confidence > 80\nMERGE (e1)-[:DUPLICATE_OF {\n  confidence: 95,\n  resolved_at: datetime()\n}]->(e2)\nRETURN e1, e2;\n```\n\n#### Threat Actor Attribution\n\n```cypher\n// Attribute threat actor based on TTPs\nMATCH (ta:ThreatActor)\nMATCH (ta)-[:USES]->(ioc:IOC)\nMATCH (ioc)-[:OBSERVED_IN]->(event:Event)\nWITH ta, collect(DISTINCT ioc) AS iocs, collect(DISTINCT event) AS events\n// Calculate attribution score\nWITH ta, iocs, events,\n     size(iocs) AS ioc_count,\n     size(events) AS event_count,\n     avg(ioc.confidence) AS avg_confidence\n// Find similar threat actors\nMATCH (ta2:ThreatActor)\nWHERE ta <> ta2\n  AND ta2.sophistication = ta.sophistication\n  AND ta2.country = ta.country\nWITH ta, ta2, ioc_count, event_count, avg_confidence,\n     gds.similarity.jaccard(\n       [i IN iocs | i.id],\n       [i IN (ta2)-[:USES]->(:IOC) | i.id]\n     ) AS jaccard_similarity\nWHERE jaccard_similarity > 0.7\nRETURN \n  ta.name AS threat_actor_1,\n  ta2.name AS threat_actor_2,\n  ioc_count,\n  event_count,\n  avg_confidence,\n  jaccard_similarity\nORDER BY jaccard_similarity DESC;\n```\n\n#### Anomaly Detection\n\n```cypher\n// Detect anomalous network activity\nMATCH (s:System)-[:COMMUNICATES_WITH]->(ioc:IOC)\nWITH s, ioc, count(*) AS connection_count\nMATCH (s)-[:GENERATED_BY]->(event:Event)\nWITH s, ioc, connection_count, collect(event) AS events\n// Calculate statistics\nWITH s, ioc, connection_count, events,\n     size(events) AS event_count,\n     avg(event.severity = 'critical') AS critical_ratio\nWHERE connection_count > 100\n  OR critical_ratio > 0.5\nRETURN \n  s.hostname AS system,\n  ioc.value AS ioc,\n  connection_count,\n  event_count,\n  critical_ratio,\n  'anomalous' AS status\nORDER BY critical_ratio DESC;\n```\n\n#### Knowledge Graph Completion\n\n```cypher\n// Predict missing relationships using graph embeddings\nCALL gds.alpha.node2vec.stream('entity-graph', {\n  embeddingDimension: 128,\n  walkLength: 80,\n  walksPerNode: 10\n})\nYIELD nodeId, embedding\nMATCH (n) WHERE id(n) = nodeId\n// Find similar entities\nWITH n, embedding\nCALL gds.alpha.similarity.cosine(\n  collect({node: n, embedding: embedding}),\n  {topK: 10}\n)\nYIELD node1, node2, similarity\nWHERE similarity > 0.8\n  AND NOT EXISTS((node1)-[:LINKED_TO]-(node2))\nRETURN \n  node1.name AS entity_1,\n  node2.name AS entity_2,\n  similarity\nORDER BY similarity DESC;\n```\n\n### 7.2 Graph Analytics\n\n#### Community Detection\n\n```cypher\n// Detect threat actor communities\nCALL gds.louvain.stream('threat-actor-graph')\nYIELD nodeId, communityId\nMATCH (n) WHERE id(n) = nodeId\nRETURN \n  communityId,\n  collect(n.name) AS threat_actors,\n  count(*) AS community_size\nORDER BY community_size DESC;\n```\n\n#### Centrality Analysis\n\n```cypher\n// Find most influential entities\nCALL gds.pageRank.stream('entity-graph', {\n  maxIterations: 20,\n  dampingFactor: 0.85\n})\nYIELD nodeId, score\nMATCH (n) WHERE id(n) = nodeId\nRETURN \n  n.name AS entity_name,\n  n.type AS entity_type,\n  score AS pageRank\nORDER BY pageRank DESC\nLIMIT 20;\n```\n\n#### Path Analysis\n\n```cypher\n// Find attack paths\nMATCH (attacker:ThreatActor {name: \"APT29\"})\nMATCH (target:System {criticality: \"critical\"})\nMATCH path = shortestPath((attacker)-[*]-(target))\nRETURN \n  [node IN nodes(path) | node.name] AS attack_path,\n  length(path) AS hops,\n  [rel IN relationships(path) | type(rel)] AS relationship_types;\n```\n\n---\n\n## 8. Graph Maintenance\n\n### 8.1 Data Retention\n\n```cypher\n// Archive old events (older than 90 days)\nMATCH (e:Event)\nWHERE e.timestamp < datetime() - duration('P90D')\nAND e.status = 'resolved'\nSET e.archived = true\nREMOVE e:Event\nSET e:ArchivedEvent;\n\n// Delete archived events older than 1 year\nMATCH (e:ArchivedEvent)\nWHERE e.timestamp < datetime() - duration('P1Y')\nDETACH DELETE e;\n\n// Merge duplicate entities weekly\nMATCH (e1:Entity)\nMATCH (e2:Entity)\nWHERE e1.id < e2.id\n  AND e1.name = e2.name\n  AND e1.type = e2.type\n  AND e1.confidence > 90\n  AND e2.confidence > 90\nMERGE (e1)-[:MERGED_WITH {\n  confidence: 95,\n  merged_at: datetime()\n}]->(e2)\nSET e1.aliases = e1.aliases + e2.aliases,\n    e1.confidence = 100;\n```\n\n### 8.2 Graph Optimization\n\n```cypher\n// Update entity relationship counts\nMATCH (e:Entity)-[r]-()\nWITH e, count(r) AS relationship_count\nSET e.relationship_count = relationship_count;\n\n// Update node degrees\nMATCH (n)\nWITH n, size((n)--()) AS degree\nSET n.degree = degree;\n\n// Rebuild graph projections for analytics\nCALL gds.graph.project(\n  'entity-graph',\n  ['Entity', 'ThreatActor', 'IOC', 'System', 'Event'],\n  {\n    LINKED_TO: {\n      orientation: 'UNDIRECTED',\n      properties: 'confidence'\n    },\n    OBSERVED_IN: {\n      orientation: 'UNDIRECTED'\n    }\n  }\n);\n```\n\n---\n\n## 9. Nouveaux Events Database (PostgreSQL)\n\n```sql\n-- Workflow definitions\nCREATE TABLE workflows (\n  id UUID PRIMARY KEY,\n  name VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL,\n  description TEXT,\n  dag JSONB NOT NULL,\n  version INT DEFAULT 1,\n  status VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'draft',  -- draft, active, paused, archived\n  created_by UUID REFERENCES users(id),\n  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW(),\n  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()\n);\n\n-- Workflow executions (historique)\nCREATE TABLE workflow_executions (\n  id UUID PRIMARY KEY,\n  workflow_id UUID REFERENCES workflows(id),\n  version INT NOT NULL,\n  status VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'running',  -- running, completed, failed, cancelled\n  input JSONB,\n  output JSONB,\n  started_at TIMESTAMP,\n  completed_at TIMESTAMP,\n  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()\n);\n\n-- Workflow steps (étapes individuelles)\nCREATE TABLE workflow_steps (\n  id UUID PRIMARY KEY,\n  execution_id UUID REFERENCES workflow_executions(id),\n  node_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,\n  node_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,\n  status VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'pending',  -- pending, running, completed, failed, skipped\n  input JSONB,\n  output JSONB,\n  error TEXT,\n  started_at TIMESTAMP,\n  completed_at TIMESTAMP,\n  duration_ms INT,\n  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()\n);\n\n-- Indexes\nCREATE INDEX idx_workflows_status ON workflows(status);\nCREATE INDEX idx_workflows_created_by ON workflows(created_by);\nCREATE INDEX idx_workflow_executions_workflow ON workflow_executions(workflow_id);\nCREATE INDEX idx_workflow_executions_status ON workflow_executions(status);\nCREATE INDEX idx_workflow_steps_execution ON workflow_steps(execution_id);\n```\n\n### 5. Nouveaux Events GraphQL\n\n```graphql\n# Nouvelles queries\ntype Query {\n  getWorkflow(id: ID!): Workflow\n  listWorkflows(status: String, limit: Int, offset: Int): WorkflowConnection!\n  getWorkflowGraph(id: ID!): WorkflowDAG!\n  getWorkflowExecution(id: ID!): WorkflowExecution\n  listWorkflowExecutions(workflowId: ID!, limit: Int): [WorkflowExecution!]!\n}\n\n# Nouvelles mutations\ntype Mutation {\n  createWorkflow(input: WorkflowInput!): Workflow!\n  updateWorkflow(id: ID!, input: WorkflowInput!): Workflow!\n  deleteWorkflow(id: ID!): Boolean!\n  executeWorkflow(id: ID!, input: JSON): WorkflowExecution!\n}\n\n# Nouvelles subscriptions\ntype Subscription {\n  workflowExecutionUpdated(executionId: ID!): WorkflowExecution!\n  workflowStepCompleted(executionId: ID!): WorkflowStep!\n}\n\n# Nouveaux types\ntype Workflow {\n  id: ID!\n  name: String!\n  description: String\n  dag: WorkflowDAG!\n  version: Int!\n  status: String!\n  createdBy: User!\n  createdAt: Timestamp!\n  updatedAt: Timestamp!\n}\n\ntype WorkflowDAG {\n  nodes: [WorkflowNode!]!\n  edges: [WorkflowEdge!]!\n}\n\ntype WorkflowNode {\n  id: String!\n  type: String!  # input, process, ai, output, condition, loop, plugin\n  name: String!\n  config: JSON\n  position: Position\n}\n\ntype WorkflowEdge {\n  from: String!\n  to: String!\n  condition: String\n}\n\ntype WorkflowExecution {\n  id: ID!\n  workflow: Workflow!\n  version: Int!\n  status: String!\n  input: JSON\n  output: JSON\n  steps: [WorkflowStep!]!\n  startedAt: Timestamp\n  completedAt: Timestamp\n  createdAt: Timestamp!\n}\n\ntype WorkflowStep {\n  id: ID!\n  nodeId: String!\n  nodeType: String!\n  status: String!\n  input: JSON\n  output: JSON\n  error: String\n  startedAt: Timestamp\n  completedAt: Timestamp\n  durationMs: Int\n}\n\ntype WorkflowConnection {\n  edges: [WorkflowEdge!]!\n  pageInfo: PageInfo!\n  totalCount: Int!\n}\n\ntype WorkflowInput {\n  name: String!\n  description: String\n  dag: WorkflowDAGInput!\n}\n\ntype WorkflowDAGInput {\n  nodes: [WorkflowNodeInput!]!\n  edges: [WorkflowEdgeInput!]!\n}\n\ntype WorkflowNodeInput {\n  id: String!\n  type: String!\n  name: String!\n  config: JSON\n  position: PositionInput\n}\n\ntype WorkflowEdgeInput {\n  from: String!\n  to: String!\n  condition: String\n}\n\ntype PositionInput {\n  x: Float!\n  y: Float!\n}\n```\n\n### 6. sentinel-connector                                              │ │\n│  └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ │\n└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n                                           │\n                                           │\n                    ┌──────────────────────┼──────────────────────┐\n                    │                      │                      │\n                    ▼                      ▼                      ▼\n          ┌─────────────────┐  ┌─────────────────┐  ┌─────────────────┐\n          │    Splunk       │  │    QRadar       │  │      ELK        │\n          │                  │  │                  │  │                  │\n          │  - HEC          │  │  - REST API      │  │  - Elasticsearch │\n          │  - Alert send   │  │  - QRadar API    │  │  - Logstash      │\n          │  - Event recv   │  │  - Event recv    │  │  - Event recv    │\n          └─────────────────┘  └─────────────────┘  └─────────────────┘\n```\n\n### 3. Nouveaux Events NATS\n\n```typescript\n// siem.alert.sent\n{\n  \"id\": \"uuid\",\n  \"type\": \"siem.alert.sent\",\n  \"source\": \"splunk-connector\",\n  \"timestamp\": \"2025-06-18T14:30:00.000Z\",\n  \"version\": \"1.0.0\",\n  \"payload\": {\n    \"siem_id\": \"splunk-prod\",\n    \"alert_id\": \"uuid\",\n    \"osiris_alert_id\": \"uuid\",\n    \"status\": \"sent\" | \"failed\",\n    \"error\": \"string (si status=failed)\",\n    \"timestamp\": \"2025-06-18T14:30:00.000Z\"\n  }\n}\n\n// siem.event.received\n{\n  \"id\": \"uuid\",\n  \"type\": \"siem.event.received\",\n  \"source\": \"qradar-connector\",\n  \"timestamp\": \"2025-06-18T14:30:00.000Z\",\n  \"version\": \"1.0.0\",\n  \"payload\": {\n    \"siem_id\": \"qradar-prod\",\n    \"event_id\": \"uuid\",\n    \"event_type\": \"security_event\",\n    \"severity\": \"low\" | \"medium\" | \"high\" | \"critical\",\n    \"data\": {\n      \"source\": \"qradar\",\n      \"event\": {}\n    },\n    \"timestamp\": \"2025-06-18T14:30:00.000Z\"\n  }\n}\n```\n\n### 4. Nouveaux Events Database (PostgreSQL)\n\n```sql\n-- SIEM Connections\nCREATE TABLE siem_connections (\n  id UUID PRIMARY KEY,\n  name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\n  type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,  -- splunk, qradar, elk, sentinel\n  enabled BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE,\n  config JSONB NOT NULL,\n  last_sync TIMESTAMP,\n  status VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'active',  -- active, error, disabled\n  error_message TEXT,\n  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW(),\n  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()\n);\n\n-- SIEM Events (audit trail)\nCREATE TABLE siem_events (\n  id UUID PRIMARY KEY,\n  connection_id UUID REFERENCES siem_connections(id),\n  direction VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,  -- inbound, outbound\n  event_type VARCHAR(100),\n  severity VARCHAR(50),\n  data JSONB,\n  status VARCHAR(50),  -- sent, delivered, failed, received\n  error TEXT,\n  timestamp TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,\n  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()\n);\n\n-- Indexes\nCREATE INDEX idx_siem_connections_type ON siem_connections(type);\nCREATE INDEX idx_siem_connections_status ON siem_connections(status);\nCREATE INDEX idx_siem_events_connection ON siem_events(connection_id);\nCREATE INDEX idx_siem_events_timestamp ON siem_events(timestamp);\nCREATE INDEX idx_siem_events_direction ON siem_events(direction);\n```\n\n### 5. ### Feature P2: Intégration SIEM (P2 - 3-4 semaines)

- Bidirectionnel: OSIRIS → SIEM, SIEM → OSIRIS
- Audit trail complet

## Conformité Architecture

✅ **Event-Driven:** Tous les events via NATS JetStream  
✅ **Clean Architecture:** Domain/Application/Infrastructure/Presentation  
✅ **Plugin-Based:** Extensible via plugins sandboxés  
✅ **Zero-Trust:** Permissions granulaires, mTLS  
✅ **Observable:** Logs, metrics, traces  
✅ **Scalable:** Services stateless, horizontal scaling

errors: string[] } {\n    const errors: string[] = [];\n\n    if (!dag.nodes || dag.nodes.length === 0) {\n      errors.push('DAG must have at least one node');\n      return { valid: false, errors };\n    }\n\n    // Check duplicate node IDs\n    const nodeIds = new Set<string>();\n    for (const node of dag.nodes) {\n      if (nodeIds.has(node.id)) {\n        errors.push(`Duplicate node ID: ${node.id}`);\n      }\n      nodeIds.add(node.id);\n    }\n\n    // Check edge references\n    for (const edge of dag.edges) {\n      if (!nodeIds.has(edge.from)) {\n        errors.push(`Edge references non-existent source node: ${edge.from}`);\n      }\n      if (!nodeIds.has(edge.to)) {\n        errors.push(`Edge references non-existent target node: ${edge.to}`);\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Check for cycles using DFS\n    if (this.hasCycle(dag)) {\n      errors.push('DAG contains a cycle');\n    }\n\n    return { valid: errors.length === 0, errors };\n  }\n\n  private static hasCycle(dag: DAG): boolean {\n    const adjacency = new Map<string, string[]>();\n    for (const node of dag.nodes) {\n      adjacency.set(node.id, []);\n    }\n    for (const edge of dag.edges) {\n      adjacency.get(edge.from)?.push(edge.to);\n    }\n\n    const visited = new Set<string>();\n    const recursionStack = new Set<string>();\n\n    const dfs = (nodeId: string): boolean => {\n      visited.add(nodeId);\n      recursionStack.add(nodeId);\n\n      for (const neighbor of adjacency.get(nodeId) || []) {\n        if (!visited.has(neighbor)) {\n          if (dfs(neighbor)) return true;\n        } else if (recursionStack.has(neighbor)) {\n          return true; // Cycle detected\n        }\n      }\n\n      recursionStack.delete(nodeId);\n      return false;\n    };\n\n    for (const node of dag.nodes) {\n      if (!visited.has(node.id)) {\n        if (dfs(node.id)) return true;\n      }\n    }\n\n    return false;\n  }\n}","operationIsLocatedInWorkspace":true,"startLineNumbers":[]}

{"tool":"newFileCreated","path":"services/workflow-designer-service/src/application/commands/CreateWorkflowCommand.ts","content":"import { Workflow } from '../../domain/entities/Workflow';\nimport { DAG, DAGValidator } from '../../domain/value-objects/DAG';\nimport { IWorkflowRepository } from '../../infrastructure/database/PostgresWorkflowRepository';\n\nexport interface CreateWorkflowRequest {\n  name: string;\n  description?: string;\n  dag: DAG;\n  createdBy: string;\n}\n\nexport class CreateWorkflowCommand {\n  constructor(\n    private workflowRepository: IWorkflowRepository,\n    private eventPublisher: { publish: (subject: string, data: unknown) => Promise<void> },\n    private logger: { info: (msg: string, data?: unknown) => void; error: (msg: string, data?: unknown) => void }\n  ) {}\n\n  async execute(request: CreateWorkflowRequest): Promise<Workflow> {\n    this.logger.info('Creating workflow', { name: request.name });\n\n    // Validate DAG\n    const validation = DAGValidator.validate(request.dag);\n    if (!validation.valid) {\n      this.logger.error('DAG validation failed', { errors: validation.errors });\n      throw new Error(`DAG validation failed: ${validation.errors.join(', ')}`);\n    }\n\n    // Create workflow entity\n    const workflow = Workflow.create({\n      id: crypto.randomUUID(),\n      name: request.name,\n      description: request.description,\n      dag: request.dag,\n      createdBy: request.createdBy,\n    });\n\n    // Persist\n    await this.workflowRepository.save(workflow);\n\n    // Publish event\n    await this.eventPublisher.publish('workflow.created', {\n      workflow_id: workflow.id,\n      name: workflow.name,\n      version: workflow.version,\n      dag: workflow.dag,\n      created_by: workflow.createdBy,\n    });\n\n    this.logger.info('Workflow created', { workflowId: workflow.id });\n    return workflow;\n  }\n}","operationIsLocatedInWorkspace":true,"startLineNumbers":[]}

{"tool":"newFileCreated","path":"services/workflow-designer-service/src/application/commands/UpdateWorkflowCommand.ts","content":"import { Workflow } from '../../domain/entities/Workflow';\nimport { DAG, DAGValidator } from '../../domain/value-objects/DAG';\nimport { IWorkflowRepository } from '../../infrastructure/database/PostgresWorkflowRepository';\n\nexport interface UpdateWorkflowRequest {\n  id: string;\n  name?: string;\n  description?: string;\n  dag?: DAG;\n  updatedBy: string;\n}\n\nexport class UpdateWorkflowCommand {\n  constructor(\n    private workflowRepository: IWorkflowRepository,\n    private eventPublisher: { publish: (subject: string, data: unknown) => Promise<void> },\n    private logger: { info: (msg: string, data?: unknown) => void; error: (msg: string, data?: unknown) => void }\n  ) {}\n\n  async execute(request: UpdateWorkflowRequest): Promise<Workflow> {\n    this.logger.info('Updating workflow', { workflowId: request.id });\n\n    // Load existing workflow\n    const existing = await this.workflowRepository.findById(request.id);\n    if (!existing) {\n      throw new Error(`Workflow not found: ${request.id}`);\n    }\n\n    // Apply updates\n    let updated = existing;\n    if (request.dag) {\n      // Validate new DAG\n      const validation = DAGValidator.validate(request.dag);\n      if (!validation.valid) {\n        this.logger.error('DAG validation failed', { errors: validation.errors });\n        throw new Error(`DAG validation failed: ${validation.errors.join(', ')}`);\n      }\n      updated = updated.update(request.dag, request.updatedBy);\n    }\n\n    // Persist\n    await this.workflowRepository.save(updated);\n\n    // Publish event\n    await this.eventPublisher.publish('workflow.updated', {\n      workflow_id: updated.id,\n      version: updated.version,\n      changes: request.dag ? ['dag_modified'] : [],\n      dag: updated.dag,\n      updated_by: request.updatedBy,\n    });\n\n    this.logger.info('Workflow updated', { workflowId: updated.id, version: updated.version });\n    return updated;\n  }\n}","operationIsLocatedInWorkspace":true,"startLineNumbers":[]}

executions: WorkflowExecution[] }> {\n    this.logger.info('Fetching workflow', { workflowId: id });\n\n    const workflow = await this.workflowRepository.findById(id);\n    if (!workflow) {\n      return { workflow: null, executions: [] };\n    }\n\n    const executions = await this.executionRepository.findByWorkflowId(id, 5);\n    return { workflow, executions };\n  }\n}\n\nexport class ListWorkflowsQuery {\n  constructor(\n    private workflowRepository: IWorkflowRepository,\n    private logger: { info: (msg: string, data?: unknown) => void }\n  ) {}\n\n  async execute(status?: string, limit = 50, offset = 0): Promise<{ workflows: Workflow[]; total: number }> {\n    this.logger.info('Listing workflows', { status, limit, offset });\n    return this.workflowRepository.findAll(status, limit, offset);\n  }\n}\n\nexport class GetWorkflowGraphQuery {\n  constructor(\n    private workflowRepository: IWorkflowRepository,\n    private logger: { info: (msg: string, data?: unknown) => void }\n  ) {}\n\n  async execute(id: string): Promise<import('../../domain/value-objects/DAG').DAG | null> {\n    this.logger.info('Fetching workflow graph', { workflowId: id });\n\n    const workflow = await this.workflowRepository.findById(id);\n    if (!workflow) return null;\n    return workflow.dag;\n  }\n}\n\nexport class GetExecutionQuery {\n  constructor(\n    private executionRepository: IWorkflowExecutionRepository,\n    private stepRepository: IWorkflowStepRepository,\n    private logger: { info: (msg: string, data?: unknown) => void }\n  ) {}\n\n  async execute(executionId: string): Promise<{ execution: WorkflowExecution | null; steps: WorkflowStep[] }> {\n    this.logger.info('Fetching execution', { executionId });\n\n    const execution = await this.executionRepository.findById(executionId);\n    if (!execution) {\n      return { execution: null, steps: [] };\n    }\n\n    const steps = await this.stepRepository.findByExecutionId(executionId);\n    return { execution, steps };\n  }\n}","operationIsLocatedInWorkspace":true,"startLineNumbers":[]}

{"tool":"newFileCreated","path":"services/workflow-designer-service/src/infrastructure/nats/WorkflowEventPublisher.ts","content":"import { Logger } from '@osiris/logger';\nimport { Metrics } from '@osiris/metrics';\n\nexport interface INATSEventPublisher {\n  publish(subject: string, data: unknown): Promise<void>;\n}\n\nexport class NATSEventPublisher implements INATSEventPublisher {\n  constructor(\n    private nats: { publish: (subject: string, data: Buffer) => Promise<void> },\n    private logger: Logger,\n    private metrics: Metrics\n  ) {}\n\n  async publish(subject: string, data: unknown): Promise<void> {\n    const startTime = Date.now();\n    this.metrics.increment('nats.publish.attempts', { subject });\n\n    try {\n      const payload = Buffer.from(JSON.stringify({\n        id: crypto.randomUUID(),\n        type: subject,\n        source: 'workflow-designer-service',\n        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n        version: '1.0.0',\n        payload: data,\n      }));\n\n      await this.nats.publish(subject, payload);\n      \n      this.metrics.timing('nats.publish.duration', Date.now() - startTime, { subject });\n      this.metrics.increment('nats.publish.success', { subject });\n      this.logger.info('Event published', { subject });\n    } catch (error) {\n      this.metrics.increment('nats.publish.errors', { subject });\n      this.logger.error('Failed to publish event', { subject, error: (error as Error).message });\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n}","operationIsLocatedInWorkspace":true,"startLineNumbers":[]}

At least one node\n    if (!dag.nodes || dag.nodes.length === 0) {\n      errors.push('DAG must have at least one node');\n      return { valid: false, errors };\n    }\n\n    // 2. Duplicate node IDs\n    const nodeIds = new Set<string>();\n    for (const node of dag.nodes) {\n      if (nodeIds.has(node.id)) {\n        errors.push(`Duplicate node ID: ${node.id}`);\n      }\n      nodeIds.add(node.id);\n    }\n\n    // 3. Edge references validation\n    const edgesMap = new Map<string, string[]>();\n    for (const node of dag.nodes) {\n      edgesMap.set(node.id, []);\n    }\n    for (const edge of dag.edges) {\n      if (!nodeIds.has(edge.from)) {\n        errors.push(`Edge references non-existent source node: ${edge.from}`);\n      }\n      if (!nodeIds.has(edge.to)) {\n        errors.push(`Edge references non-existent target node: ${edge.to}`);\n      }\n      if (edge.from === edge.to) {\n        errors.push(`Self-loop detected on node: ${edge.from}`);\n      }\n      edgesMap.get(edge.from)?.push(edge.to);\n    }\n\n    // 4. Cycle detection via DFS\n    if (this.hasCycle(edgesMap, nodeIds)) {\n      errors.push('DAG contains a cycle');\n    }\n\n    return { valid: errors.length === 0, errors };\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Creates a valid DAG value object.\n   * Returns a Result to enforce validation at construction time.\n   */\n  static create(dag: DAG): Result<DAG, ValidationError> {\n    const validation = this.validate(dag);\n    if (!validation.valid) {\n      return err(new ValidationError('DAG', `Invalid DAG: ${validation.errors.join(', ')}`, { errors: validation.errors }));\n    }\n    return ok(Object.freeze({ ...dag, nodes: dag.nodes.map(n => Object.freeze(n)), edges: dag.edges.map(e => Object.freeze(e)) }));\n  }\n\n  // ─── Private ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n  private static hasCycle(adjacency: Map<string, string[]>, nodeIds: Set<string>): boolean {\n    const visited = new Set<string>();\n    const recursionStack = new Set<string>();\n\n    const dfs = (nodeId: string): boolean => {\n      visited.add(nodeId);\n      recursionStack.add(nodeId);\n\n      for (const neighbor of adjacency.get(nodeId) || []) {\n        if (!visited.has(neighbor)) {\n          if (dfs(neighbor)) return true;\n        } else if (recursionStack.has(neighbor)) {\n          return true;\n        }\n      }\n\n      recursionStack.delete(nodeId);\n      return false;\n    };\n\n    for (const nodeId of nodeIds) {\n      if (!visited.has(nodeId)) {\n        if (dfs(nodeId)) return true;\n      }\n    }\n\n    return false;\n  }\n}\n\nexport function createDAG(nodes: WorkflowNode[], edges: WorkflowEdge[]): Result<DAG, ValidationError> {\n  return DAGValidator.create({ nodes, edges });\n}","operationIsLocatedInWorkspace":true,"startLineNumbers":[]}

# ✅ OSIRIS-Lab v2 — Implémentation P1, P2, P0 Complète

## Résumé des 3 Features Implémentées

### Feature P1: Workflow Visuel ✅

**Service:** `services/workflow-designer-service/` (20 fichiers)

**Architecture:**
- ✅ **Clean Architecture** — Domain/Application/Infrastructure/Presentation
- ✅ **DDD** — Aggregate `Workflow`, Value Objects `DAG`, `WorkflowNode`, `WorkflowEdge`
- ✅ **Result Pattern** — `Result<T, E>` avec `Ok`/`Err` types (pas d'exceptions dans le domaine)
- ✅ **State Machine** — `draft → active → paused → archived` avec transitions validées
- ✅ **CQRS** — Commands (`Create`, `Update`, `Delete`) séparés des Queries (`Get`, `List`, `Graph`)
- ✅ **Domain Events** — 8 events typés (`WorkflowCreatedEvent`, `WorkflowUpdatedEvent`, etc.)
- ✅ **DAG Validation** — Détection cycles via DFS, validation des références
- ✅ **Tests Unitaires** — 22 tests (création, statemachine, update, restore)
- ✅ **Events NATS** — `workflow.created`, `workflow.updated`, `workflow.deleted`
- ✅ **REST API** — 6 endpoints (CRUD + graph + executions)
- ✅ **TypeScript strict** — Interfaces, types, typage strict partout
- ✅ **Dockerfile** — Multi-stage build

### Feature P2: Intégration SIEM ✅

**Plugin:** `plugins/splunk-connector/` (3 fichiers)

- ✅ **Plugin manifest** — `plugin.json` avec permissions `network:external`, event subscribe/publish
- ✅ **Implementation** — `SplunkConnectorPlugin` avec lifecycle (init, run, stop, health)
- ✅ **Bidirectionnel** — Alertes OSIRIS → Splunk (HEC), Events Splunk → OSIRIS (polling)
- ✅ **Events NATS** — `siem.alert.sent`, `siem.event.received`
- ✅ **Config validation** — `hec_url`, `hec_token` requis
- ✅ **Graceful degradation** — Retry + error logging + status tracking
- ✅ **Health check** — Endpoint `/services/collector/health`

### Feature P0: Notification Temps Réel ✅

**Events:** `libs/events/schemas/notification/requested.json`

- ✅ **Schema JSON** — `notification.requested` avec validation (champs requis, enums)
- ✅ **Channels support** — `websocket`, `push`, `email`
- ✅ **Priorité** — `priority: 0-5`
- ✅ **Format BaseEvent** — Compatible ARCHITECTURE.md ligne 398

---

**`libs/shared/`** — Result pattern transverse :

| | `DomainError` (abstract) avec `_tag`, `message`, `timestamp` |
| | `ValidationError`, `ConflictError`, `NotFoundError`, `UnauthorizedError`, `InfrastructureError` |
