{"tool":"editedExistingFile","path":"services/workflow-designer-service/src/application/commands/CreateWorkflowCommand.ts","content":"/**\n * OSIRIS-Lab v2 — Workflow Designer Service\n * \n * CQRS Command: CreateWorkflow\n * Creates a new workflow aggregate with DAG validation.\n */\n\nimport { Result, ok, err, InfrastructureError } from '@osiris/shared/domain/Result';\nimport { Workflow, WorkflowErrors, WorkflowProps } from '../../domain/entities/Workflow';\nimport { DAG } from '../../domain/value-objects/DAG';\nimport { IWorkflowRepository } from '../../infrastructure/repositories/IWorkflowRepository';\nimport { INATSEventPublisher } from '../../infrastructure/nats/WorkflowEventPublisher';\n\nexport interface CreateWorkflowRequest {\n  name: string;\n  description?: string;\n  dag: DAG;\n  createdBy: string;\n}\n\nexport type CreateWorkflowResponse = WorkflowProps;\n\nexport class CreateWorkflowCommand {\n  constructor(\n    private readonly workflowRepository: IWorkflowRepository,\n    private readonly eventPublisher: INATSEventPublisher,\n    private readonly logger: { info: (msg: string, data?: Record<string, unknown>) => void; error: (msg: string, data?: Record<string, unknown>) => void }\n  ) {}\n\n  async execute(request: CreateWorkflowRequest): Promise<Result<CreateWorkflowResponse, WorkflowErrors | InfrastructureError>> {\n    this.logger.info('Creating workflow', { name: request.name });\n\n    // 1. Create Workflow aggregate (validates name + DAG)\n    const workflowResult = Workflow.create({\n      id: crypto.randomUUID(),\n      name: request.name,\n      description: request.description,\n      dag: request.dag,\n      createdBy: request.createdBy,\n    });\n\n    if (workflowResult.isErr()) {\n      this.logger.error('Workflow creation validation failed', { errors: workflowResult.error.message });\n      return workflowResult;\n    }\n\n    const workflow = workflowResult.unwrap();\n\n    // 2. Persist aggregate\n    const saveResult = await this.workflowRepository.save(workflow);\n    if (saveResult.isErr()) {\n      this.logger.error('Failed to persist workflow', { error: saveResult.error.message });\n      return err(saveResult.error);\n    }\n\n    // 3. Publish domain event to NATS\n    try {\n      await this.eventPublisher.publish('workflow.created', {\n        workflow_id: workflow.id,\n        name: workflow.name,\n        version: workflow.version,\n        dag: workflow.dag,\n        created_by: workflow.createdBy,\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      this.logger.error('Failed to publish workflow.created event', { error: (error as Error).message });\n      return err(new InfrastructureError('NATSEventPublisher', 'publish', error as Error));\n    }\n\n    this.logger.info('Workflow created successfully', { workflowId: workflow.id, version: workflow.version });\n    return ok(workflow.toJSON());\n  }\n}","operationIsLocatedInWorkspace":true,"startLineNumbers":[]}

# ✅ Feature P1: Workflow Visuel — Refactoring Complet avec Result Pattern + Tests

## Architecture Finale

### Domain Layer (DDD + Result Pattern)

| Fichier | Lignes | Description |
|---------|--------|-------------|
| `entities/Workflow.ts` | 166 | Aggregate Root avec state machine (`draft→active→paused→archived`) |
| `entities/WorkflowExecution.ts` | 127 | Execution aggregate (`running→completed/failed/cancelled`) |
| `entities/WorkflowStep.ts` | 127 | Step entity (`pending→running→completed/failed/skipped`) |
| `value-objects/DAG.ts` | 121 | DAG validator + Value Objects immutables |
| `events/WorkflowEvents.ts` | 100 | 8 domain events typés avec `_tag` discriminant |

### Application Layer (CQRS)

| Couche | Classes | Description |
|--------|---------|-------------|
| **Commands** | `CreateWorkflowCommand` | Création avec validation DAG + persistence + event NATS |
| | `UpdateWorkflowCommand` | Update avec DAG validation + version increment |
| | `DeleteWorkflowCommand` | Delete avec vérification existence |
| **Queries** | `GetWorkflowQuery` | Workflow + executions récentes |
| | `ListWorkflowsQuery` | Pagination, filtre par status |
| | `GetWorkflowGraphQuery` | Récupération du DAG |
| | `GetExecutionQuery` | Execution + steps |
| **Repositories** | `IWorkflowRepository` | Interface avec Result pattern |
| | `IWorkflowExecutionRepository` | Interface Result pattern |
| | `IWorkflowStepRepository` | Interface Result pattern |

### Infrastructure Layer

| Fichier | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `postgres/PostgresWorkflowRepository.ts` | 3 repositories PostgreSQL avec UPSERT |
| `nats/WorkflowEventPublisher.ts` | Publisher NATS avec metrics + format BaseEvent |
| `migrations/001_create_workflows.sql` | 3 tables + 6 indexes + contraintes CHECK |

### Tests Unitaires

**35 tests** couvrant :

**Workflow Aggregate (22 tests):**
- ✅ Création valide/invalide (name, DAG cycles, empty)
- ✅ State machine (draft→active→paused→active→archived)
- ✅ Transitions invalides bloquées (activate depuis active, pause depuis draft)
- ✅ Update DAG avec version increment + domain events
- ✅ Restore from persistence

**DAGValidator (13 tests):**
- ✅ DAG valide simple, disconnected, diamond
- ✅ DAG invalide (empty, duplicate nodes, bad refs, self-loops)
- ✅ Cycle detection direct (A→B→A) et indirect (A→B→C→A)
- ✅ Immutability du DAG retourné

### Patterns Respectés

| Pattern | Statut | Implémentation |
|---------|--------|----------------|
| **Clean Architecture** | ✅ | Domain/Application/Infrastructure/Presentation séparés |
| **DDD** | ✅ | Aggregate Workflow, Value Objects DAG, Domain Events |
| **Result Pattern** | ✅ | `Result<T, E>` avec Ok/Err, pas d'exceptions |
| **CQRS** | ✅ | Commands (create, update, delete) ≠ Queries (get, list, graph) |
| **SOLID** | ✅ | SRP, OCP, LSP, ISP, DIP via interfaces repositories |
| **Event Driven** | ✅ | Domain events → NATS publisher → `workflow.*` subjects |
| **Immutability** | ✅ | `Object.freeze()` sur props, DAG, nodes, edges |
| **Error Handling** | ✅ | `ValidationError`, `ConflictError`, `InfrastructureError`, `NotFoundError` |

}\n  get workflowId(): string { return this.props.workflowId; }\n  get version(): number { return this.props.version; }\n  get status(): ExecutionStatus { return this.props.status; }\n  get input(): Record<string, unknown> | undefined { return this.props.input; }\n  get output(): Record<string, unknown> | undefined { return this.props.output; }\n  get startedAt(): Date | undefined { return this.props.startedAt; }\n  get completedAt(): Date | undefined { return this.props.completedAt; }\n  get createdAt(): Date { return this.props.createdAt; }\n\n  // ─── State Machine ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n  start(): WorkflowExecution {\n    return new WorkflowExecution({ ...this.props, status: 'running', startedAt: new Date() });\n  }\n\n  complete(output: Record<string, unknown>): Result<WorkflowExecution, ConflictError> {\n    if (this.props.status !== 'running') {\n      return err(new ConflictError('WorkflowExecution', `Cannot complete in status: ${this.props.status}`));\n    }\n    return ok(new WorkflowExecution({ ...this.props, status: 'completed', output, completedAt: new Date() }));\n  }\n\n  fail(error: Record<string, unknown>): Result<WorkflowExecution, ConflictError> {\n    if (this.props.status !== 'running') {\n      return err(new ConflictError('WorkflowExecution', `Cannot fail in status: ${this.props.status}`));\n    }\n    return ok(new WorkflowExecution({ ...this.props, status: 'failed', output: error, completedAt: new Date() }));\n  }\n\n  cancel(): Result<WorkflowExecution, ConflictError> {\n    if (this.props.status !== 'running') {\n      return err(new ConflictError('WorkflowExecution', `Cannot cancel in status: ${this.props.status}`));\n    }\n    return ok(new WorkflowExecution({ ...this.props, status: 'cancelled', completedAt: new Date() }));\n  }\n\n  toJSON(): WorkflowExecutionProps {\n    return { ...this.props };\n  }\n}","operationIsLocatedInWorkspace":true,"startLineNumbers":[]}

* - At least 1 node\n   * - Max 100 nodes, 500 edges (memory protection)\n   * - No duplicate IDs\n   * - All edge refs exist\n   * - No cycles (DFS)\n   */\n  static validate(dag: DAG): };\n    }\n    if (dag.nodes.length > MAX_NODES) {\n      errors.push(`DAG exceeds maximum nodes (${MAX_NODES}): ${dag.nodes.length}`);\n    }\n    if (dag.edges.length > MAX_EDGES) {\n      errors.push(`DAG exceeds maximum edges (${MAX_EDGES}): ${dag.edges.length}`);\n    }\n\n    const nodeIds = new Set<string>();\n    for (const node of dag.nodes) {\n      if (nodeIds.has(node.id)) errors.push(`Duplicate node ID: ${node.id}`);\n      nodeIds.add(node.id);\n    }\n\n    const adjacency = new Map<string, string[]>();\n    for (const node of dag.nodes) adjacency.set(node.id, []);\n\n    for (const edge of dag.edges) {\n      if (!nodeIds.has(edge.from)) errors.push(`Edge references non-existent source: ${edge.from}`);\n      if (!nodeIds.has(edge.to)) errors.push(`Edge references non-existent target: ${edge.to}`);\n      if (edge.from === edge.to) errors.push(`Self-loop detected: ${edge.from}`);\n      adjacency.get(edge.from)?.push(edge.to);\n    }\n\n    if (this.hasCycle(adjacency)) errors.push('DAG contains a cycle');\n\n    return { valid: errors.length === 0, errors };\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Creates a frozen, validated DAG value object.\n   */\n  static create(dag: DAG): Result<DAG, ValidationError> {\n    const v = this.validate(dag);\n    if (!v.valid) return err(new ValidationError('DAG', `Invalid DAG: ${v.errors.join(', ')}`, { errors: v.errors }));\n    return ok(Object.freeze({\n      nodes: dag.nodes.map(n => Object.freeze({ ...n })),\n      edges: dag.edges.map(e => Object.freeze({ ...e })),\n    }));\n  }\n\n  private static hasCycle(adjacency: Map<string, string[]>): boolean {\n    const visited = new Set<string>();\n    const stack = new Set<string>();\n\n    const dfs = (id: string): boolean => {\n      visited.add(id); stack.add(id);\n      for (const n of adjacency.get(id) || []) {\n        if (!visited.has(n)) { if (dfs(n)) return true; }\n        else if (stack.has(n)) return true;\n      }\n      stack.delete(id);\n      return false;\n    };\n\n    for (const id of adjacency.keys()) {\n      if (!visited.has(id) && dfs(id)) return true;\n    }\n    return false;\n  }\n}\n\nexport function {"tool":"editedExistingFile","path":"services/workflow-designer-service/src/domain/entities/WorkflowStep.ts","content":"/**\n * OSIRIS-Lab v2 — Workflow Designer Service\n * \n * DDD Entity: WorkflowStep\n * Tracks individual step execution within a workflow.\n * State machine: pending → running → completed | failed | skipped\n * \n * Référence: docs/BACKEND_ARCHITECTURE.md §8.1 (Node.js service example)\n */\n\nimport { Result, ok, err, ConflictError } from '../../../../libs/shared/src/domain/Result';\nimport { StepStatus } from '../value-objects/DAG';\n\nexport interface WorkflowStepProps {\n  id: string;\n  executionId: string;\n  nodeId: string;\n  nodeType: string;\n  status: StepStatus;\n  input?: Record<string, unknown>;\n  output?: Record<string, unknown>;\n  error?: string;\n  startedAt?: Date;\n  completedAt?: Date;\n  durationMs?: number;\n  createdAt: Date;\n}\n\nexport class WorkflowStep {\n  private readonly props: WorkflowStepProps;\n\n  private constructor(props: WorkflowStepProps) {\n    this.props = Object.freeze({ ...props });\n  }\n\n  static create(props: Omit<WorkflowStepProps, 'status' | 'createdAt'>): WorkflowStep {\n    return new WorkflowStep({ ...props, status: 'pending', createdAt: new Date() });\n  }\n\n  static restore(props: WorkflowStepProps): WorkflowStep {\n    return new WorkflowStep(props);\n  }\n\n  get id(): string { return this.props.id; }\n  get executionId(): string { return this.props.executionId; }\n  get nodeId(): string { return this.props.nodeId; }\n  get nodeType(): string { return this.props.nodeType; }\n  get status(): StepStatus { return this.props.status; }\n  get input(): Record<string, unknown> | undefined { return this.props.input; }\n  get output(): Record<string, unknown> | undefined { return this.props.output; }\n  get error(): string | undefined { return this.props.error; }\n  get startedAt(): Date | undefined { return this.props.startedAt; }\n  get completedAt(): Date | undefined { return this.props.completedAt; }\n  get durationMs(): number | undefined { return this.props.durationMs; }\n  get createdAt(): Date { return this.props.createdAt; }\n\n  start(): WorkflowStep {\n    return new WorkflowStep({ ...this.props, status: 'running', startedAt: new Date() });\n  }\n\n  complete(output: Record<string, unknown>): Result<WorkflowStep, ConflictError> {\n    if (this.props.status !== 'running' && this.props.status !== 'pending') {\n      return err(new ConflictError('WorkflowStep', `Cannot complete in status: ${this.props.status}`));\n    }\n    const completedAt = new Date();\n    const durationMs = this.props.startedAt ? completedAt.getTime() - this.props.startedAt.getTime() : 0;\n    return ok(new WorkflowStep({ ...this.props, status: 'completed', output, completedAt, durationMs }));\n  }\n\n  fail(errorMsg: string): Result<WorkflowStep, ConflictError> {\n    if (this.props.status !== 'running' && this.props.status !== 'pending') {\n      return err(new ConflictError('WorkflowStep', `Cannot fail in status: ${this.props.status}`));\n    }\n    const completedAt = new Date();\n    const durationMs = this.props.startedAt ? completedAt.getTime() - this.props.startedAt.getTime() : 0;\n    return ok(new WorkflowStep({ ...this.props, status: 'failed', error: errorMsg, completedAt, durationMs }));\n  }\n\n  skip(): WorkflowStep {\n    return new WorkflowStep({ ...this.props, status: 'skipped', completedAt: new Date() });\n  }\n\n  toJSON(): WorkflowStepProps { return { ...this.props }; }\n}","operationIsLocatedInWorkspace":true,"startLineNumbers":[]}

GetWorkflow, ListWorkflows, GetGraph, GetExecution\n│\n├── infrastructure/               # Adaptateurs externes\n│   ├── database/\n│   │   ├── PostgresWorkflowRepository.ts  # 3 repositories (Workflow, Execution, Step)\n│   │   └── migrations/\n│   │       ├── 001_create_workflows.sql\n│   │       └── 002_add_performance_indexes.sql\n│   ├── nats/\n│   │   └── WorkflowEventPublisher.ts    # Publisher NATS avec metrics\n│   └── repositories/\n│       └── IWorkflowRepository.ts       # Interfaces Result pattern\n│\n└── presentation/                 # Couche HTTP\n    ├── routes/\n    │   └── workflow.routes.ts    # 6 endpoints REST\n    └── index.ts                  # Entry point Express\n\ntests/\n└── unit/\n    ├── domain/\n    │   ├── workflow.test.ts      # 22 tests (création, state machine, update)\n    │   └── dag-validator.test.ts # docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §5.1 (Alert events)\n */\n\nimport { BaseSIEMConnector, PluginContext, SIEMConnectionError, SIEMAuthError, SIEMRateLimitError } from '@osiris/siem-plugin-sdk';\nimport axios, { AxiosInstance } from 'axios';\n\ninterface SplunkConfig {\n  hec_url: string;\n  hec_token: string;\n  poll_interval?: number;\n  index?: string;\n  timeout?: number;\n}\n\ninterface AlertPayload {\n  alert_id: string;\n  alert_type: string;\n  severity: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'critical';\n  title: string;\n  description: string;\n  entities: string[];\n  iocs: string[];\n  context: Record<string, unknown>;\n}\n\nexport class SplunkConnector extends BaseSIEMConnector {\n  private client: AxiosInstance | null = null;\n  private pollTimer: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null = null;\n  private config!: SplunkConfig;\n\n  get type(): string { return 'splunk'; }\n  get name(): string { return 'Splunk SIEM Connector'; }\n\n  async run(context: PluginContext): Promise<void> {\n    this.config = context.config as unknown as SplunkConfig;\n\n    if (!this.config.hec_url || !this.config.hec_token) {\n      throw new Error('Splunk connector requires hec_url and hec_token');\n    }\n\n    const masked = this.config.hec_token.substring(0, 4) + '****';\n    context.logger.info('Initializing Splunk connector', { hec_url: this.config.hec_url, token: masked });\n\n    this.client = axios.create({\n      baseURL: this.config.hec_url.replace(/\\/$/, ''),\n      headers: { 'Authorization': `Splunk ${this.config.hec_token}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },\n      timeout: this.config.timeout || 30000,\n    });\n\n    // Subscribe to alerts from OSIRIS\n    await context.nats.subscribe('alert.triggered', async (data: unknown) => {\n      const alert = data as AlertPayload;\n      context.logger.info('Forwarding alert to Splunk', { alert_id: alert.alert_id });\n\n      try {\n        const result = await this.sendAlert(alert, context);\n        if (result.isOk()) {\n          await context.nats.publish('siem.alert.sent', {\n            siem_id: 'splunk-prod',\n            alert_id: alert.alert_id,\n            osiris_alert_id: alert.alert_id,\n            status: 'sent',\n            timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n          });\n        } else {\n          await context.nats.publish('siem.alert.sent', {\n            siem_id: 'splunk-prod',\n            alert_id: alert.alert_id,\n            osiris_alert_id: alert.alert_id,\n            status: 'failed',\n            error: result.error.message,\n            timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n          });\n        }\n      } catch (e) {\n        context.logger.error('Failed to forward alert', { alert_id: alert.alert_id, error: (e as Error).message });\n      }\n    });\n\n    // Poll Splunk for external events\n    const interval = this.config.poll_interval || 30000;\n    this.pollTimer = setInterval(async () => {\n      try {\n        const events = await this.pollEvents(context);\n        if (events.isOk()) {\n          for (const event of events.unwrap()) {\n            await context.nats.publish('siem.event.received', {\n              siem_id: 'splunk-prod',\n              event_id: event.eventId,\n              event_type: event.eventType,\n              severity: event.severity,\n              data: event.data,\n              timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n            });\n          }\n        }\n      } catch (e) {\n        context.logger.error('Splunk poll failed', { error: (e as Error).message });\n      }\n    }, interval);\n\n    this.initialized = true;\n    this.healthy = true;\n    context.logger.info('Splunk connector running', { poll_interval: interval });\n\n    return new Promise(() => {});\n  }\n\n  async sendAlert(alert: unknown, _context: PluginContext) {\n    const payload = alert as AlertPayload;\n    return this.withRetry(async () => {\n      const hecEvent = {\n        event: payload,\n        sourcetype: 'osiris:alert',\n        source: 'osiris-lab-v2',\n        host: 'osiris-platform',\n        time: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000),\n        index: this.config.index || 'osiris_alerts',\n      };\n      const res = await this.client!.post('/services/collector/event', hecEvent);\n      if (res.status !== 200) throw new Error(`Splunk HEC returned ${res.status}`);\n      return { sent: true, id: res.data?.id };\n    }, 3, 1000);\n  }\n\n  async pollEvents(_context: PluginContext) {\n    const { ok } = await import('@osiris/shared/domain/Result');\n    return ok([]);\n  }\n\n  async testConnection(_context: PluginContext) {\n    const { ok, err } = await import('@osiris/shared/domain/Result');\n    try {\n      await this.client!.get('/services/collector/health');\n      this.healthy = true;\n      return ok(true);\n    } catch (e) {\n      this.healthy = false;\n      return err(new SIEMConnectionError('splunk', 'testConnection', (e as Error).message));\n    }\n  }\n\n  async stop(context: PluginContext): Promise<void> {\n    if (this.pollTimer) clearInterval(this.pollTimer);\n    this.initialized = false;\n    this.healthy = false;\n    context.logger.info('Splunk connector stopped');\n  }\n}\n\n// Plugin entry point\nconst plugin = new SplunkConnector();\nexport default
